title: Quantum Causal Discovery via Amplitude Estimation of Kullback-Leibler Divergence
summary: Causal discovery from observational data underpins applications in finance, climate modeling, and machine learning. Constraint-based causal discovery reduces structure learning to a sequence of conditional independence (CI) tests, where each test decides independence by estimating conditional mutual information $I(X;Y \mid Z)$ to additive precision $τ$ and thresholding against it. Classically this requires $Θ(1/τ^{2})$ samples per test, a cost that dominates in the high-precision regime typical of weak dependencies.
